bibl.title: Copying practices in Ptolemaic Egypt. A discussion based on Greek agoranomic contracts from Pathyris.
bibl.seg: Marja Vierros, Copying practices in Ptolemaic Egypt. A discussion based on Greek agoranomic contracts from Pathyris.
bibl.note: Introduction. - Part I. Descriptions of the duplicate documents and the orphan copies from Pathyris. - Part II. Copying practices in the Pathyrite agoranomic contracts: 1. Handwriting, scriptio continua and syllabification; - 2. Physical appearance and layout; - 3. Writing of numbers; - 4. Other abbreviations; - 5. Omissions and additions; - 6. Self-corrections; - 7. Copyist choosing different forms than original; - 8. Not using different forms i.e. repeating mistakes; - 9. Differences in word order; - 10. Egyptian names; - 11. Iota adscript. - Conclusions.
